title.narrative: Strengthening Women & Youth participation in Peacebuilding and Civic Spaces in Conflict Hotspots in Leer & Rubkona

description.narrative: The Strengthening Women and Youth participation in Peacebuilding and Civic Spaces in Conflict Hotspots in Leer and Rubkona County Unity State. It seeks to build leadership capacity and create and/or strengthen existing platforms to expand engagement and active participation of youth and women. The approach aims at addressing gender inequality, women and youth marginalization, and limited access to political space using in-person solutions. This will be achieved by involving women and youth in identifying issues related to peace building, reconciliation and governance in their respective communities, and strengthen communities’ socio-cultural ties that support community relationships, and build peace. Empowering women and youth to take lead in activities geared towards peacebuilding, participation and inclusion will overcome the negative impacts on Women and Youth Peace and Security and promote lasting peace. In addition, holding public forums to create awareness on the drivers of conflict and mitigation, holding women and youth led dialogues to come up with resolutions is a good step towards peacebuilding, reconciliation, increase participation in Governance and peaceful coexistence. More so, BY engaging the host communities and the IDPs/returnees in intergenerational dialogues and organizing sports marathons the project will bring together youth and women to work together on peace initiatives which will intern promote reconciliation and peaceful coexistence among the different groups of people.
